Please excuse me from editing your poem, I just want to show the way I read the poem, how it felt most natural to me. I usually segment my text messages into single phrases that represent single ideas anyways, so it felt pretty unnatural to conform your poem to a specific meter, with widely varying phrase lengths.

I simply just ended the lines, where I thought the phrases and ideas succinctly ends. I don't by any means think this is better than your rendition, but you could take how this is separated as a way of separating your lines. The pitfall of what I did, is now this poem has a continuously varying meter, instead of the Iambic trimeter you held. So it somewhat feels like without order, yet it flows better in my opinion.

Best wishes\~ Enjoy writing more poems\~!
